svg.title: Five Sub-Niches, One Consistent Spread Measure
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-contractual-rate-spreads; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Sub-Niches, One Consistent Spread Measure; subtitle: Compare contractual rate-spread proxies, not borrower APR or investor return.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are annual percentage-point differences between illustrative wrap and underlying note rates. Rates are examples, not market quotes. Unequal balances, amortization, defaults, fees, escrow, and prepayments change actual retained yield.; caption: At equal $100,000 interest-only balances, one percentage point equals $1,000 annual gross interest spread. Actual underwriting must model both amortization schedules and monthly cash timing.; stages: label: Clean-payment low-equity resale; value: 3.0 percentage points from 6.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $3,000 annually per $100,000. Use licensed-servicer ACH collections and verify senior-lender settlement rather than relying on a buyer payment screenshot.; label: Relocation seller with seasoned debt; value: 3.5 percentage points from 7.0% less 3.5%; numeric value: 3.5; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $3,500 annually per $100,000. Confirm occupancy and insurance changes, obtain a complete payment history, and model seller release separately from the property transfer.; label: Documented reinstatement opportunity; value: 4.0 percentage points from 7.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $4,000 annually per $100,000. A higher spread can disappear after arrears, reinstatement fees, foreclosure deadlines, and a delayed first wrap payment.; label: Self-employed owner-occupant buyer; value: 4.5 percentage points from 8.0% less 3.5%; numeric value: 4.5; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $4,500 annually per $100,000. Require RMLO-reviewed income evidence and repayment capacity; a larger down payment does not replace the required underwriting analysis.; label: Texas covered wrap transaction; value: 5.0 percentage points from 8.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $5,000 annually per $100,000. Price only after reviewing Texas Finance Code Chapter 159, Property Code §5.016, applicable rate limits, licensing, and required disclosures.

text.title: Five Sub-Niches, One Consistent Spread Measure
text.tspan: Five Sub-Niches, One Consistent Spread Measure

rect.title: label: Clean-payment low-equity resale; value: 3.0 percentage points from 6.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $3,000 annually per $100,000. Use licensed-servicer ACH collections and verify senior-lender settlement rather than relying on a buyer payment screenshot.

label: Relocation seller with seasoned debt; value: 3.5 percentage points from 7.0% less 3.5%; numeric value: 3.5; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $3,500 annually per $100,000. Confirm occupancy and insurance changes, obtain a complete payment history, and model seller release separately from the property transfer.

label: Documented reinstatement opportunity; value: 4.0 percentage points from 7.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $4,000 annually per $100,000. A higher spread can disappear after arrears, reinstatement fees, foreclosure deadlines, and a delayed first wrap payment.

label: Self-employed owner-occupant buyer; value: 4.5 percentage points from 8.0% less 3.5%; numeric value: 4.5; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $4,500 annually per $100,000. Require RMLO-reviewed income evidence and repayment capacity; a larger down payment does not replace the required underwriting analysis.

label: Texas covered wrap transaction; value: 5.0 percentage points from 8.5% less 3.5%; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Illustrative equal-balance gross spread is $5,000 annually per $100,000. Price only after reviewing Texas Finance Code Chapter 159, Property Code §5.016, applicable rate limits, licensing, and required disclosures.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are annual percentage-point differences between illustrative wrap and underlying note rates. Rates are examples, not market quotes. Unequal balances, amortization, defaults, fees, escrow, and prepayments change actual retained yield.
